title: Finite ring-sheaf coordinates of one normalized refinement
statement: Fix a prime $\ell$, a finite extension $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ and an integer $n\ge0$. Put $A=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^{n+1})$ and let $S$ be the actual finite coefficient ring-sheaf datum [def-pur-integral-compact-support-coefficient-data]. Let $X,Y$ be arbitrary schemes, $f:X\to Y$, $c=(j_c,p_c)$ and $d=(j_d,p_d)$ compactifications of $f$, and $r:c\to d$ a proper refinement [def-weil-compactifications-refinements]. Let $O$ consist of a complex $K$ on the pro-etale site of $X$, a bounded-below etale complex $L$, and a specified isomorphism from the canonical realization of $L$ to $K$ [def-weil-frobenius-witnessed-compactification]. Supply the coefficient pullback composition equalities for $j_c r=j_d$ and $r p_d=p_c$. Let $\epsilon:j_{d,!}K\simeq Rr_*j_{c,!}K$ have its open-adjunction transpose followed by the pullback-composition/proper-counit restriction equal to the open unit at $K$. Then the inverse proper compositor followed by $Rp_{d,*}(\epsilon^{-1})$, followed by finiteImageIso at $d$, equals finiteImageIso at $c$ followed by intrinsicRefinement at $(r,O)$ [lem-pur-compact-support-integral-coefficient-comparison, def-weil-frobenius-witnessed-compactification]. This is equality of single isomorphisms on $K$; it asserts no identity or composition law and uses no exceptional construction data.

proof.text: The units of both open derived adjunctions are invertible by openDerivedAdjunction_unit_isIso. For an isomorphism epsilon, its transpose is the open unit followed by restriction of epsilon, hence invertible. Since that transpose followed by the restriction factor equals the other invertible open unit, the restriction factor is invertible. Cancel it between the two normalization equations, then apply injectivity of the adjunction Hom equivalence and Iso.ext. Thus epsilon equals epsilon_0. This argument applies to identity and empty opens and zero objects.

theorem finite_ring_refinement_coordinates
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type w) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (n : ℕ)
    {X Y : Scheme.{w}} {f : X ⟶ Y} {c d : Compactification f} (r : c.Refinement d)
    (O : FrobeniusExchange.CompactOrigin
      (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) X)
    (hi : (PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)).pull (c.i ≫ r.hom) =
      proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients c.i r.hom
        ((PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)).ring d.Z)
        ((PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)).ring c.Z)
        ((PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)).ring X)
        ((PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)).pull r.hom)
        ((PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)).pull c.i))
    (hg : (PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)).pull (r.hom ≫ d.g) =
      proEtaleRingCompositeCoefficients r.hom d.g
        ((PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)).ring Y)
        ((PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)).ring d.Z)
        ((PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)).ring c.Z)
        ((PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)).pull d.g)
        ((PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)).pull r.hom))
    (ε : (PurCompactSupport.openExtension
        (PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)) d.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj O.K ≅
      (PurCompactSupport.push (PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n))
        r.hom).obj ((PurCompactSupport.openExtension
          (PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)) c.i).mapDerivedCategory.obj O.K))
    (hε : (PurCompactSupport.openDerivedAdjunction
        (PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)) d.i).homEquiv _ _ ε.hom ≫
      PurCompactSupport.refinementRestriction
        (PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)) r hi O.K =
      (PurCompactSupport.openDerivedAdjunction
        (PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)) c.i).unit.app O.K) :
    ((PurCompactSupport.geometricPushComposition
        (PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)) r.hom d.g hg ≪≫
      eqToIso (congrArg (fun h ↦ PurCompactSupport.push
        (PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)) h) r.hom_g)).symm.app _) ≪≫
      (PurCompactSupport.push
        (PurCompactSupport.finite l E (n + 1) (Nat.succ_pos n)) d.g).mapIso ε.symm ≪≫
      (PurCompactSupport.finiteImageIso l E n d).app O.K =
    (PurCompactSupport.finiteImageIso l E n c).app O.K ≪≫
      FrobeniusExchange.intrinsicRefinement
        (Padic.coefficientExtensionRing l E (n + 1)) r O
